results.detail: Checked against the raw DTSX. Is Renewal.Outputs[Renewal] and AppendixType.Outputs[AppendixTypeNeedToSendMail] both have errorRowDisposition=FailComponent (DTSX:5518, 5317). Paths: Lookup Match -> Is Renewal; Lookup No Match -> Union All -> No Email; Not Renewal -> Update NeedToSendMailBit -> AppendixType; Renewal and AppendixTypeNoMail -> Union All. Is Renewal condition: agentcyIdNumberPa == agentcyIdNumber. agentcyIdNumber of the waiting POA cannot be NULL, because the outer 'WaitingPoas.agentcyIdNumber not in (...)' drops NULLs. agentcyIdNumberPa = isnull(Contact.Gen_Identitynumber, Account.AccountNumber) from LEFT JOINs (DTSX:5543), so it can be NULL. The OLE DB Command runs the UPDATE for the row before AppendixType receives it. A waiting POA with NULL appendix and no match goes to No Email without evaluation. Handle Active Status is reached only on Success (Constraint 16, DTSX:8223). The NULL-condition error is labelled as general SSIS behaviour.
